current.text: He is not in the projected Warriors starting lineups. The projected starters are Curry, Podziemski, Lendeborg, Green and Horford or Porzingis.
Golden State's depth is very poor. The team struggles to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody are out early in the season. Butler is out for at least half the season.
Steve Kerr runs unpredictable rotations and often changes his starting lineup a few games after announcing it, with lots of mixing among the wings.
The Warriors may treat this season as a gap year. They are worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans.

durable.text: He scores by slipping screens and cutting to the basket off Curry's gravity. He does not create his own shot.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 266, ESPN 196), and nobody drafted him in our league last season. In about 15 to 16 minutes a game he gives an efficient but low-volume FG% (58% on 5 to 6 attempts) and few turnovers, and very little anywhere else, so he is not one of our 144 auction players. Early in the season, check whether the thin Warriors depth and the absences of Butler and Moody push his minutes clearly above 16. Only then is he worth a waiver look.
